description: Pip Shield (Uncommon perk) in House of Pips: Whenever a malus lowers a scoring play, restore up to 5 points per stack.
html:
Perks › Uncommon

Pip Shield

Uncommon perk · Malus protection

Whenever a malus lowers a scoring play, restore up to 5 points per stack.

In-game card text

How it works

When a malus lowers one of your scoring plays, Pip Shield gives back up to 5 of the lost points for each copy.

  • It covers Cracked Doubles, Five Jinx and Perk Tax, the maluses that act on a scoring play.
  • It never gives back more than the maluses took from that play.
  • It does nothing for maluses that act elsewhere, such as Leaky Pocket or the hand award maluses.

Worked example

You play a total of 5 with Five Alive (5 + 5 = 10) while holding Five Jinx. Five Jinx takes all 10 points. One Pip Shield restores 5, so the play still scores 5.

At a glance

RarityUncommon
TypeMalus protection
Needs a scoring playYes. It only fires when the open-end total is a positive multiple of 5.
How to get itUnlock it in the Perks compendium for 300 Bone Bucks once you own 5 Common perks.
